title: Pan-Seared Reblochon with Kissed Floral Glaze
description: A rich and creamy French-inspired dish featuring Reblochon cheese, served with a sweet and sticky floral glaze. Perfect for a cozy dinner.
instructions: Slice the Reblochon cheese into 1-inch thick rounds.
Season the cheese with Croatian thyme and a pinch of salt.
In a skillet, melt the kissed butter over medium heat.
Add the cheese to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Transfer the skillet to the oven and bake for 5-7 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Meanwhile, mix the floral honey with a tablespoon of water in a small bowl.
Remove the skillet from the oven and brush the floral honey glaze over the cheese.
Serve the pan-seared Reblochon with sliced skillet bread on the side.
Garnish with additional Croatian thyme and a drizzle of floral honey, if desired.
